business_summary: The Toho Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides various banking products and services in Japan. The company operates through four segments: Banking, Leasing, Credit Guarantee, and Others. It offers accounts; debit, credit, and cash cards; time and foreign currency deposits, investment trusts, government bonds, and securities trading; home, personal, card, and online-only loans; and whole life, medical and cancer, educational, personal pension, income protection/term life, internet-only, and home loan-specific fire insurance, as well as individual defined contribution pension plans, national pension funds, and inheritance and trust-related services. The company also provides web-based direct debit, pay-easy account transfer acceptance, safe deposit boxes, foreign currency exchange, international money transfer, electronic delivery, and free dial information request services; internet banking; fundraising; administrative rationalization; overseas business support; fund management; business consulting; mergers and acquisitions; corporate pension and retirement allowance systems; and densai services. In addition, it is involved in leasing services; computer software development and computer-based computing services; printing and binding services for documents and other forms; business succession support; IT-related services; and human resources-related businesses. The company was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Fukushima, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Toho Bank, Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 일본에서 다양한 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 은행, 임대, 신용 보증 및 기타의 네 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 계정을 제공합니다. 직불카드, 신용카드, 현금카드; 정기예금 및 외화예금, 투자신탁, 국채 및 증권거래; 주택, 개인, 카드 및 온라인 전용 대출; 종신보험, 의료암보험, 교육보험, 개인연금, 소득보장/정기생명보험, 인터넷전용보험, 주택담보대출특화화재보험, 개인확정기여형연금, 국민연금, 상속 및 신탁 관련 서비스를 제공합니다. 회사는 또한 웹 기반 자동 이체, 간편 계좌 이체 승인, 안전 금고, 외화 환전, 국제 송금, 전자 배송 및 무료 전화 정보 요청 서비스를 제공합니다. 인터넷뱅킹; 모금 활동; 행정 합리화; 해외사업지원; 자금 관리; 비즈니스 컨설팅; 합병 및 인수; 기업 연금 및 퇴직금 제도; 그리고 densai 서비스. 또한 임대 서비스에도 참여하고 있습니다. 컴퓨터 소프트웨어 개발
